_documentation: Golden-region allowlist for the Section Builder v3.1 remediation (register §A M2).
Detection convention + comparison/exit-code semantics are documented in the header
comment of scripts/golden-allowlist.mjs, which reads this file. Do not hand-edit
startLine/endLine into this file — the script recomputes ranges from the live
source on every run; only 'id' (file::name), 'golden', 'register', and 'note' are
read from here. 'id' MUST equal '<file>::<declaration name>' or the script will
report the corresponding live block as UNCLASSIFIED.
Seeded 2026-07-13 (mission remediation/r0-foundation, phase R0 slice R0b) from a
live run of `node scripts/golden-allowlist.mjs` against the then-current source —
§C S4-A (LEGACY-NOT-IN-GOLDEN). Several S4-A rows describe cross-file regions
(templates/layout.ts, ui.ts) outside this gate's two scanned files, or a mix of
golden-legit and non-golden content inside one function; those approximations are
called out per-row below. The actual purge is phase R5 — this file is the R0
foundation seed, not a final classification.

blocks.note: Bootstrap data blob (seed templates + type-meta JSON payload) — shared plumbing, not a visual region.
Top bar chrome — not flagged as a non-golden region in register §C.

PROPOSED reclassification (implementer, pending conductor ratification): the R5 census split this MIXED block into two. (1) S4-A2's legacy Maps/validation fieldset is REMOVED entirely (R5 D2 fieldset removal — no replacement DOM element; state.address_validation_enabled round-trips via the #lg-section-data JSON blob only, proven in-function by the inline comment + test/leadgen-r5-* coverage). (2) S4-A8's Activity/Vertical pickers are EXTRACTED to their own top-level block, renderActivityVerticalPickers (below), which keeps the golden:false classification. What remains in THIS function — the eyebrow, the On-answer segmented control, the Maps-connected chip, and the golden-legit headline/subheadline inputs (S4-B1) — has no other register citation flagging it non-golden, so the function is reclassified golden:true now that its non-golden content has moved to an independently classifiable sibling block.

R5 census split (extracted from renderStudioSettings, which used to carry this MIXED-in): the Activity/Vertical '+New...' pickers + styled-placeholder-pill empty state. No golden position exists for this group (it was moved into the question strip from the top bar in an earlier phase, unrelated to golden fidelity) — accepted, functionally necessary, non-golden extension, now its own classifiable block per the split.
Component-library tile renderer — golden §5 component library.
Quote-Builder callout — not flagged.
Content-trust-scope callout — not flagged.
Palette/library rail shell — not flagged (S4-A groups only flag specific sub-regions elsewhere, not the library rail itself).
Canvas iframe document assembly — shared plumbing for the canvas surface, not itself a flagged region (the iframe MODEL is register S4-B6, a golden-divergent row, out of this gate's A-axis scope).
Canvas srcdoc string builder — shared plumbing, same note as studioCanvasDocument.
Frame-hint decorative skeleton — legit golden feature (contract §5.4).
Scope pills — not flagged.

PROPOSED reclassification (implementer, pending conductor ratification): R5 D3 removed EVERY ballooning cluster (renderToolbarLayoutCluster DELETED — its entry above is intentionally gone, not stale-orphaned, per the purge completion the E.5b arming enforces; layout/text/component/preset clusters removed or migrated to Content/Style tabs). The function now renders ONLY golden-legit chrome (breadcrumb/pills/undo/viewport/frame-hint/offer-mapping-toggle) PLUS one compact non-golden 'More actions' popover (structure + choice-item quick actions — the golden mockup depicts neither; documented judgment call per the dispatch's own carve-out) and the inline validation-problems slot. Kept golden:false for the More-popover addition alone — a MUCH smaller divergence than pre-R5.

Canvas surface shell — the iframe-vs-flex-column MODEL divergence is register S4-B6 (golden-divergent, 'iframe kept, errata'), a different axis (B = both have it, shipped wrong) than this gate's A-axis (region not in golden at all).
Helper consumed only by renderDesignPanel/renderLayoutPanel (S4-A4) — no independent golden use.
Generic scope header shell — not flagged.

Inspector tab-shell assembly (Content/Style/Rules/Maps/Offers/Advanced). The tab SYSTEM itself is golden per contract; specific nested panels it calls (renderDesignPanel/renderLayoutPanel = S4-A4, renderPreviewPanel = S4-A5, renderSectionOverridesPanel = S4-A6) are tracked as their OWN blocks below — kept golden:true here to avoid double-counting the same defect at two nesting levels.

Bottom-drawer 'Preview' panel = a dev/QA console (pickers, mapping overlay, refresh, state simulator, dependency-JSON textarea, events-would-fire log, 2 iframes) — golden's drawer is a bar only (golden :371-387). Per the mission's operator-resolved decision, this stays behind an explicit 'QA tools' toggle in R5, not removed outright.
Bottom-drawer 4th tab 'Design overrides' (14 role swatches + columns/gap) — golden shows exactly 3 items + theme switcher + Expand. Self-flagged non-golden in its own source per the register.
Drawer shell (bar + 4 tabs). 2 of its 4 tabs are the separately-tracked non-golden panels above (S4-A5/S4-A6); kept golden:true here for the same double-counting reason as renderStudioInspector.
Media picker — not flagged.
Top-level studio page assembly — golden shell; non-golden sub-parts are tracked as their own blocks above/below.

Shared plumbing (the whole inline stylesheet), not a single visual region. Register S4-A12 (orphaned .studio-activity/.studio-vertical dead CSS, P2) lives inside this constant as a specific dead-rule hygiene item, tracked separately in the register rather than by this gate.
Shared plumbing (the whole inline ES5 behavior island), not a single visual region.

Sections-LIST page toolbar — same note as renderSectionListRow.

PROPOSED reclassification (implementer, pending conductor ratification): the R5 full-bleed grant resolved two of the three original MIXED reasons directly — S4-A1's admin-shell wrap is gone (switched to leadgenStandalonePageShell, templates/layout.ts grant 1) and S4-A9's LeadGen sub-tabs row is dropped (renderLeadgenTabs no longer called here). The remaining reason, S4-A10 (the 'New Section' pubid span + 2 alert placeholders), is now EXTRACTED to its own top-level block, renderSectionEditorChrome (below), which keeps the golden:false classification. What remains in THIS function is pure page-assembly (isNew/view/statusPillHtml computation, the outer div wrapper, the leadgenStandalonePageShell call) plus calls to two independently classified blocks (renderSectionEditorChrome = non-golden, renderSectionStudio = golden) — no independent visual content of its own, so it is reclassified golden:true now that both its non-golden reasons are either resolved or split out. Register §D W5 [DECISION]: full-bleed studio route approved by the operator.

Golden's static mockup depicts no new/unsaved/error state, so this has no golden position — accepted, functionally necessary, non-golden extension, now its own classifiable block per the split.
Error page — not flagged.

PROPOSED classification (implementer, pending conductor ratification): the Themes-manager IN-PAGE OVERLAY container (iframe + backdrop) — this IS the golden interaction itself (golden :627-721, 'Manage theme ->' opens an overlay over the studio instead of navigating away). Classified golden:true because it directly implements the golden-specified overlay mechanism, unlike the OTHER R3b additions above which are accepted-but-non-golden extensions.
